meta.policy_name: Ansible Best Practices Enforcement with JQ
meta.policy_description: Comprehensive validation of Ansible playbooks using jq_query operations to enforce security, maintainability, and operational best practices

evaluators.description: [name[play]] Verify all plays have descriptive names
[name[task]] Ensure all tasks have descriptive names for maintainability
[name[casing]] Task names should start with capital letter and not end with period

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[].name | select(. != null) | select(test("^[A-Z]") | not or test("\\.$"))] | length

evaluators.description: [name[handler]] Verify all handlers have unique descriptive names
[become] Verify become is used appropriately for privilege escalation tasks

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.apt") or has("ansible.builtin.yum") or has("ansible.builtin.systemd") or has("ansible.builtin.service")) | select(.become != true and (.[].become != true))] | length

evaluators.description: [become-user-without-become] Ensure become_user is only used with become enabled
[package-latest] Package installations should use explicit versions, not 'latest'

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.apt") or has("ansible.builtin.yum") or has("ansible.builtin.dnf") or has("ansible.builtin.package") or has("ansible.builtin.pip")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.apt"].state? == "latest") or (.["ansible.builtin.yum"].state? == "latest") or (.["ansible.builtin.dnf"].state? == "latest") or (.["ansible.builtin.package"].state? == "latest") or (.["ansible.builtin.pip"].state? == "latest"))] | length

evaluators.description: [risky-file-permissions] File permissions should not be 0777 or world-writable

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.file") or has("ansible.builtin.copy") or has("ansible.builtin.template")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.file"].mode? == "0777") or (.["ansible.builtin.copy"].mode? == "0777") or (.["ansible.builtin.template"].mode? == "0777") or (.["ansible.builtin.file"].mode? == "777") or (.["ansible.builtin.copy"].mode? == "777") or (.["ansible.builtin.template"].mode? == "777"))] | length

evaluators.description: [no-log-password] Tasks with sensitive data (password, secret, token) must use no_log

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select((.name | tostring | test("password|secret|token|key|credential"; "i")) or (. | tostring | test("password|secret|token|credential"; "i"))) | select(.no_log != true)] | length

evaluators.description: [no-changed-when] Command/shell tasks should define changed_when or creates/removes

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.command") or has("ansible.builtin.shell")) | select(.changed_when == null and (.["ansible.builtin.command"].creates? == null) and (.["ansible.builtin.command"].removes? == null) and (.["ansible.builtin.shell"].creates? == null) and (.["ansible.builtin.shell"].removes? == null))] | length

evaluators.description: [command-instead-of-shell] Use 'command' instead of 'shell' when pipes/redirects not needed

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.shell")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.shell"] | tostring | test("\\||>|<|&&|;|") | not))] | length

evaluators.description: [risky-shell-pipe] Shell tasks with pipes should use 'set -o pipefail' for safety

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.shell")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.shell"] | tostring | test("\\|")) and (.["ansible.builtin.shell"] | tostring | test("pipefail") | not))] | length

evaluators.description: [fqcn] Tasks should use Fully Qualified Collection Names (FQCN) for modules
[tags] Critical tasks should be properly tagged for selective execution
[service-enabled] Service tasks should explicitly set enabled parameter

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.systemd") or has("ansible.builtin.service")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.systemd"].enabled? == null) and (.["ansible.builtin.service"].enabled? == null))] | length

evaluators.description: [template-validation] Template tasks should have both src and dest, plus validation
[file-ownership] File/directory tasks should specify owner and group

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.file") or has("ansible.builtin.copy") or has("ansible.builtin.template")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.file"].owner? == null and .["ansible.builtin.file"].state? != "absent" and .["ansible.builtin.file"].state? != "link") or (.["ansible.builtin.copy"].owner? == null) or (.["ansible.builtin.template"].owner? == null))] | length

evaluators.description: [wait-for-timeout] wait_for tasks should have explicit timeout values
[uri-status-code] URI/API tasks should validate expected status codes
[git-version] Git clone tasks should specify explicit version/tag/commit
[handler-usage] Service restarts should use handlers, not direct tasks

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.systemd") or has("ansible.builtin.service")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.systemd"].state? == "restarted") or (.["ansible.builtin.service"].state? == "restarted")) | select(.notify == null)] | length

evaluators.description: [register-naming] Registered variables should have descriptive names ending with '_result'

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(.register != null) | select(.register | test("_result$|_output$|_response$") | not)] | length

evaluators.description: [ignore-errors] ignore_errors should be used sparingly (max 2 tasks)
[no-jinja-when] when conditions should not use Jinja2 delimiters {{ }}

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(.when != null) | select(.when | tostring | test("\\{\\{|\\}\\}"))] | length

evaluators.description: [deprecated-loop-syntax] Use 'loop' instead of deprecated 'with_items'

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(.with_items != null or .with_nested != null or .with_dict != null or .with_subelements != null)] | length

evaluators.description: [cron-user] Cron tasks should explicitly specify the user
[systemd-daemon-reload] Systemd service tasks should reload daemon when managing units
[gather-facts] gather_facts should be explicitly set in playbook
[playbook-complexity] Playbook should have at least 10 meaningful tasks
[handlers-present] Playbook should define handlers for idempotent operations
[vars-present] Playbook should use variables for configuration values
[security-hardening] Playbook should include security-related tasks (firewall, permissions)
[validation] Playbook should include validation tasks (health checks, verification)

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.uri") or has("ansible.builtin.wait_for") or has("ansible.builtin.assert") or (.tags != null and (.tags | contains(["validation"]))))] | length

evaluators.description: [retries] Network/API operations should have retry logic

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.uri") or has("ansible.builtin.get_url")) | select(.retries != null)] | length

evaluators.description: [backup] Configuration file changes should enable backup

provider_args.query: [.[].tasks[] | select(has("ansible.builtin.template") or has("ansible.builtin.copy")) | select((.["ansible.builtin.template"].backup? == true) or (.["ansible.builtin.copy"].backup? == true))] | length

evaluators.description: [info] Extract names of all critical tasks for documentation

condition.value: Create application user with locked password

evaluators.description: [info] Count security-focused tasks
[info] Extract application configuration variables
[monitoring] Verify monitoring is enabled in configuration
[security] Verify TLS/SSL is enabled for secure communications
[backup] Verify backup functionality is configured

eval_expression: (playbook_has_name && all_tasks_named && task_name_capitalization) && (become_usage_check && become_user_without_become) && (package_state_not_latest && file_permissions_not_too_open && sensitive_tasks_use_no_log) && (command_tasks_have_changed_when || shell_with_pipe_uses_pipefail) && (use_fqcn_for_modules && tasks_have_appropriate_tags) && (service_tasks_have_enabled && template_tasks_complete && file_tasks_have_owner_group) && (wait_for_tasks_have_timeout && uri_tasks_validate_status && git_tasks_specify_version) && (no_when_with_jinja_delimiters && ignore_errors_minimal) && (minimum_task_count && handlers_exist && vars_defined) && (security_tasks_exist && validation_tasks_exist) && (verify_monitoring_enabled && verify_tls_enabled && verify_backup_configured)
